description: Canonical data dictionary overlay for Stoichioomics feature display metadata. Field rows are merged with shared/schemas/stoich_feature_display_schema.json so existing display contracts remain compatible.
normalization_policy: Raw feature values remain primary unless a field-level display_transform is declared in the display schema.
missing_policy: Missing values mean the field is absent, null, non-finite, or unavailable for the selected omics branch. Coverage is estimated from sampled registered EntityRecord numeric_summary/payload_json values.

gc_composition.formula: GC-related percentage, fraction, or delta computed from nucleotide composition fields registered for the omics branch.

element_density.formula: Element count normalized by sequence length, base count, nucleotide count, or amino-acid count according to the field unit.

resource_ratio.formula: Ratio between registered elemental or molecular resource descriptors.

length_structure.formula: Length or structural descriptor imported from the source feature table or derived from sequence coordinates.

sequence_complexity.formula: Entropy, motif, or compositional complexity descriptor computed from sequence symbol frequencies.

coding_proxy.formula: Transcript coding or ORF proxy derived from transcript sequence and coding-region annotations when available.

protein_property.formula: Protein physicochemical descriptor computed from amino-acid sequence composition.

strategy_score.formula: Exploratory score derived from registered stoichiometric features and module-specific ranking logic.

other.formula: Formula is not yet formally registered for this field; use field unit, source table, and module notes for interpretation.

genome.exon_gc_percent.formula: 100 * (G + C) / (A + C + G + T) over exon-like coding bases.
genome.exon_gc_percent.missing_rule: Missing when exon sequence or coding-region base composition is unavailable.

genome.promoter_gc_percent.formula: 100 * (G + C) / (A + C + G + T) over promoter-window bases.
genome.promoter_gc_percent.missing_rule: Missing when promoter window or promoter base composition is unavailable.

genome.gc_delta_promoter_minus_exon.missing_rule: Missing when either promoter_gc_percent or exon_gc_percent is unavailable.

transcriptome.gc_content.formula: (G + C) / (A + C + G + U/T) over transcript sequence.
transcriptome.gc_content.missing_rule: Missing when transcript sequence composition is unavailable.

transcriptome.gc_percent_display.formula: 100 * gc_content when gc_content is stored as a fraction; otherwise registered display percentage.
transcriptome.gc_percent_display.missing_rule: Missing when transcript GC content is unavailable.

transcriptome.nt_entropy.formula: Shannon entropy over transcript nucleotide frequencies.
transcriptome.nt_entropy.missing_rule: Missing when transcript nucleotide counts are unavailable.

proteome.length_aa.formula: Number of amino-acid residues in the protein sequence.
proteome.length_aa.missing_rule: Missing when protein sequence length is unavailable.

proteome.N_atoms_per_aa.formula: Total nitrogen atoms in the protein sequence divided by length_aa.
proteome.N_atoms_per_aa.missing_rule: Missing when amino-acid composition or length_aa is unavailable.

proteome.S_atoms_per_aa.formula: Total sulfur atoms in the protein sequence divided by length_aa.
proteome.S_atoms_per_aa.missing_rule: Missing when cysteine/methionine composition or length_aa is unavailable.

proteome.pI.formula: Predicted isoelectric point from registered protein-sequence physicochemical computation.
proteome.pI.missing_rule: Missing when protein sequence is unavailable or pI was not computed.

proteome.gravy.formula: Grand average of hydropathy computed from amino-acid hydropathy values.
proteome.gravy.missing_rule: Missing when protein sequence is unavailable.
